issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's UML diagram declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String (problem_statement.md line 70) and the textual task refers students to the UML (problem_statement.md lines 40-41). The solution implementation declares public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This mismatch between String and int return types is likely to confuse students about the expected signature and may lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent between the problem statement and the implementation. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md so the method is declared as getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and clarify the textual hint to refer to a numeric return. Alternatively, if the exercise intends a String result, change the reference solution and any tests to return String and document the reason. Updating the UML to int is the preferred fix to match the natural numeric semantics and the provided solution.
